limitations: Real normally built production Control UI in native Chromium; official synthetic Gateway rejects the stale token and records every connect request. No live Gateway, session, credential or config changed.

Chromium CDP Input.imeSetComposition creates an actual native browser IME composition; Input.dispatchKeyEvent sends the composing Enter (keyCode 229) and the ordinary committed Enter. Event observation records actual isTrusted/isComposing without manufacturing flags.
This proves Chromium behavior only, not macOS/Windows IME or WebKit platform compatibility.
cleanup: Closed all isolated browser contexts and owned preview server. Synthetic Gateway rejects the stale token; no real Gateway, session, credential or config was touched.
